answer: Unrepeatable Response Mining. Each identity must submit a fresh answer to a challenge derived from the prior block's hash; the answer seeds a required pigment pattern that overlaps signatures so any reuse is visible. A second check inspects hardware timing variance as a forgery signal, so cloned agents cannot replay it. The agent must also forge a unique proof-of-work nonce bound to its answer and challenge. Attackers pay compute per identity plus pattern collisions that void replayed submissions, making mass sybil creation linear in real cost.
